title: How to Hold a Guitar Pick & Best Guitar Picks
summary: This beginner-focused tutorial surveys guitar picks and holding technique, recommending starting with ultra-thin nylon picks for ease of use and strumming. It introduces several pick options by thickness and material (including Dunlop USA Nylon 0.46 mm and 0.60 mm, orange Tortex, and the premium BlueChip) and explains how each affects control, click, and tone, especially on acoustic guitar. The video also demonstrates a holding method—having the pick exit from the side of the thumb for better strumming—and advises trying multiple picks at a store (buying about ten to compare feel). It notes that while picks simplify strumming and accuracy for beginners, some famous players don’t use picks, and players can switch to or away from picks as they progress.
